description.p: Chasqui is an ultra-lightweight, 100% local, and Git-native desktop API client built with Tauri v2 (Rust) and React, developed using Antigravity.

It stores requests as clean, version-controlled TOML files, secures credentials in a local AES-256-GCM encrypted vault with Argon2id, and provides built-in concurrent load testing, cURL import/export, and Git repository synchronization.
